text: I had a dream last night that I'm in Japan by myself. My friend had just gone back and left me there. She left me by myself there. I don't know why, but she went back and left me with this huge, huge, huge suitcases. Like really big suitcases that are almost as big as me. Probably bigger than her. And I was supposed to bring it all back, really. I don't know why. And, but I was trying to figure out how to do that. Since I don't know. But there was this guy. I think he was maybe the son of our tent, joint tent, of this old Japanese lady that we'd stayed with. She was this strict lady. This approving character. And I had to kind of tie up the knot to make sure I can leave without feeling guilty. Or without feeling like there's something, I'm still leaving there. I'm resolved. And I had this guy with me. And he knew what I had to do to make it right by her. He was helping me out. I don't know what he did for me, but I remember he helped me going into this corner shop. It had a slush machine. Slush? It's kind of crushed ice that is constantly blended. But there was no ice. It was a toilet slush. It was vegetable stock made noodles. Little broken noodles made out of vegetable stock. But I don't know what you're supposed to do with it. Maybe eat it. Maybe put it in hot water. Drink it. They have all sorts of machines and things like that over there. But he helped me with that. He helped me to press the right buttons. And I was feeling really grateful. Even though I don't know how I was actually going to bring the suitcases back. I didn't finish the dream. There was no resolution. There was a possibility for one. So it wasn't a nightmare.
